raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "8.50.0"

recipe:
  name: framel
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://git.ligo.org/virgo/virgoapp/Fr/-/archive/${{ version }}/Fr-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: db5603b551a5cd8c9535f5a8b91014724e06c1edaa7c8ec42e24cc1b6e7d9159

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: framel-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
            - ninja
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - make
        - cmake

  - package:
      name: libframel
    inherit: framel-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/include/
            - Library/bin/libframel.dll
            - Library/lib/libframel.*
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/framel.pc
          else:
            - include/
            - lib/libframel.*
            - lib/pkgconfig/framel.pc
    requirements:
      run_constraints:
        - libframe >=9999
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libframel", upper_bound="x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - if: win
            then:
              - m2w64-gcc-libs
              - m2w64-gcc-libs-core
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - FrameL.h
          lib:
            - if: unix
              then: framel
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" framel
    about:
      description: |
        A Common Data Frame Format for Interferometric Gravitational Wave
        Detector has been developed by VIRGO and LIGO.
        The Frame Library is a software dedicated to the frame manipulation
        including file input/output.
        This package provides the `libframel` shared library and development
        files.

  - package:
      name: framel
    inherit: framel-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/Fr*
            - Library/share/doc/
          else:
            - bin/
            - share/doc/
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
            - ninja
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - make
        - cmake
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libframel", exact=True) }}
      run_constraints:
        - libframe >=9999
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - if: win
            then:
              - m2w64-gcc-libs
              - m2w64-gcc-libs-core
    tests:
      - files:
          source:
            - data/test.gwf
        script:
          - if: win
            then: "@echo on"
          - FrChannels data/test.gwf
          - FrCheck -i data/test.gwf
          - FrCopy -i data/test.gwf -o copy.gwf
          - FrDiff -i1 data/test.gwf -i2 copy.gwf -t D1 -d 1
          - FrDump -i data/test.gwf -t D1
          - if: not win
            then:
              - FrCopy -i data/test.gwf -o copy2.gwf -f 0 -l 1 -r 10
              - FrTrend -s 1 -p trend- -d 5 -c D1 -f 925484670 -l 925484680 copy2.gwf
    about:
      description: |
        A Common Data Frame Format for Interferometric Gravitational Wave
        Detector has been developed by VIRGO and LIGO.
        The Frame Library is a software dedicated to the frame manipulation
        including file input/output.
        This package provides the FrameL command line utilities.

  - package:
      name: python-framel
    build:
      python:
        version_independent: true
      script: install-python.sh
      skip: win
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake >=3.16.0
        - ctypesgen
        - make
        # extras for cross-compiling
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libframel', exact=True) }}
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libframel', exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        by_name:
          # This is explicitly pinned exactly
          - libframel
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - framel
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
      - files:
          source:
            - test/
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
        script:
          - python -m pytest test -ra
    about:
      summary: Python interface for LIGO/Virgo Frame Library
      description: |
        A Common Data Frame Format for Interferometric Gravitational Wave
        Detector has been developed by VIRGO and LIGO.
        The Frame Library is a software dedicated to the frame manipulation
        including file input/output.
        This package provides the python bindings.

about:
  summary: LIGO/Virgo Frame Library
  description: |
